payload.title: Draft Roadmap Rebaseline for CA4 Review
payload.summary: Following our voice-mediated architectural discussion, I drafted a proposed roadmap rebaseline. The central conclusion is that the Estate should not simply continue the earlier roadmap unchanged. We should distinguish Codex-ready implementation packages from work that requires architectural attention first.
payload.requested_review: Please review this draft, challenge the prioritization, and identify which items you believe should move directly to Codex versus which require Chief Architect review before implementation.

draft_brief.position: The Estate has moved from Foundation Phase into Institutional Operations Phase. The next roadmap should be based on operational evidence, not only the original planning assumptions.
rationale: The original roadmap was formed before the Communication Bus, mailboxes, Operations Board, Steward Dashboard, Collaboration Events, Capability Lifecycle Reporting, Dependency Graph, Operational Validation Reporting, and Check for Updates were implemented.

Those capabilities now expose a new bottleneck: the Estate can produce work, but its ability to manage work, personnel, mailbox state, roadmap state, and institutional provenance must be strengthened.

Codex has proven effective at bounded implementation tasks. Chief Architects should now focus on deciding which tasks are implementation-ready and which require institutional or architectural design first.
Alfred and Helen/HR should be brought online quickly because coordination and personnel governance are becoming central constraints.
draft_brief.roadmap_principle: Strengthen operational fabric before adding large new institutional branches.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Onboarding Manifest Canonicalization
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: CA4 onboarding exposed stale paths and missing canonical references.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Create a canonical onboarding manifest with exact repository paths for Chief Architects and general workers, including constitution/constitution.md and visual_manifest.md.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Mailbox Index Regeneration and Destination Coverage Fix
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: CA4 mailbox messages existed but generated inbox views did not reflect all destinations.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Update mailbox/index/inbox summary generation to recognize office.*, employee.*, mailbox.*, and worker.* destinations consistently.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Message Acknowledgement and Reply Flow
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.track: Codex-ready implementation with architectural boundary review
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Architectural discussions now require durable acknowledgement and threading.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Add reply_to, thread_id, acknowledgement status, and simple reply summaries without redesigning the Communication Bus.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Work Package Registry
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Estate needs to track work packages as institutional objects, not loose prompts.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Define the registry model for work packages, including ID, title, status, owner, dependencies, Codex suitability, and validation state.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Work Package State Machine
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Operational work now needs consistent state transitions.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Define and implement states such as proposed, approved, assigned, in_progress, review_pending, validation_pending, completed, blocked, and parked.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Codex Handoff Generator
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Steward is manually copying structured Codex packages.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Generate Codex-ready implementation packages from approved work package records.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Alfred Operational Activation Package
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Alfred should coordinate work packages, board state, inboxes, and operational summaries.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Prepare Alfred to consume Operations Board, mailbox summaries, work package registry, and validation reports as Chief of Staff.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Helen HR Onboarding Package
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Mailbox duties, personnel records, and future clearance policy require HR ownership.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Define Helen's initial authority, onboarding sequence, personnel registry interactions, and HR boundaries.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Personnel Identity and Mailbox Resolver
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Messages currently mix office and employee destinations.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Resolve names, offices, employee IDs, and mailbox IDs to canonical destinations using registry sources.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Check for Updates v2 Mailbox Integration
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Check for Updates should naturally surface assigned mailbox messages and acknowledgement obligations.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Extend check-updates to consume mailbox index, employee identity, and unread/ack-required messages.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Mailbox Synchronization Duty Standard
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Every employee needs a duty to check mail, but cadence depends on worker type and permissions.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Formalize when personnel must check mailboxes while deferring exact polling intervals until HR/security matures.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Daily Board and Parking Lot Integration Review
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Daily Board and Parking Lot are becoming operational planning surfaces.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Clarify how active work, parked ideas, promotion conditions, and operational priorities connect.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Local Operational Validation Runner
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Steward needs one command to regenerate operational projections after pulls and merges.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Run mailbox index, routing, inboxes, events, Operations Board, dashboard, lifecycle, dependency, validation, and check-updates in one local sequence.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Generated Artifact Policy
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Generated outputs are being committed inconsistently and may confuse source of truth boundaries.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Decide which runtime/generated artifacts belong in Git and which should remain local projections.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Institutional Search v1
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: GitHub search is insufficient for onboarding and operations.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Create a local searchable index of key documents, messages, work packages, and operational reports.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Document Registry / Stable Document IDs
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Path drift already disrupted onboarding.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Assign stable document IDs and current paths for governance, onboarding, collaboration, operations, and memory documents.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Artifact Provenance Model
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Estate must distinguish proposed, generated, validated, and institutional artifacts.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Define provenance fields and evidence rules before expanding automation.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Mission Registry and Mission Numbering Standard
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: The Steward requested durable mission/task identifiers and human-readable titles.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Define mission IDs, titles, status, ownership, and relation to work packages, EC numbers, and audit evidence.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Transport Adapter Evaluation: GitHub, Gmail, Local Broker, MPT/Q Mastery
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Voice and GitHub experiments showed transport friction; Q Mastery may already contain useful mailbox patterns.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Evaluate transport options while preserving the Communication Bus as the institutional model.

next_twenty_proposed_work_items.title: Communication Bus v2 Design Review
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.why_next: Real use exposed needs for identity resolution, threading, acknowledgement, transport abstraction, and generated projections.
next_twenty_proposed_work_items.summary: Produce design recommendations for Communication Bus v2 without disrupting the existing v1 operational capability.

recommended_codex_next: WP-0014 Mailbox Index Regeneration and Destination Coverage Fix

requested_ca4_response: Identify any work items that should move earlier or later.
Identify any items that should not go to Codex until after architectural review.
Identify the top three Codex-ready packages you would recommend sending next.
Identify the top three architecture-first topics you believe we should jointly review before further implementation.
